name: Saab (SAAB B)
teaser: The price is 66% above my Base value of SEK 360 and 189% above my maximum buy price of SEK 207 at Confidence C. It sits just above my Bull value of SEK 594, so the market is already paying for the best case I can build from the numbers Saab has reported.
llms: Saab (SAAB B) makes Gripen fighters, radar and airborne surveillance, missiles and ground weapons, submarines and ship systems. Valued on ten years of discounted free cash flow to the firm and an exit multiple on EBITDA. Bear SEK 193, Base SEK 360, Bull SEK 594. Verdict: reduce at SEK 599.60, maximum buy price SEK 207.
